title: Esau moves to Seir and forms the tribes of Edom
description: The chapter tells how Esau (Edom) moved from Canaan to the mountains of Seir because his and Jacob's property had become too large for them to live together. It lists Esau's wives and descendants, the tribal chiefs who came from him, the chiefs of the Horites in the land, as well as the kings who reigned in Edom before Israel had kings.
